scope: Woodford, Interest and Prices, Chapter 5: Dynamics of the Response to Monetary Policy, with Appendix D. Predetermined expenditure and the reduction to the Chapter 4 system with determinacy transfer, the variance decomposition; small quantitative models and the Table 5.1-5.3 arithmetic; habit persistence (App D.1) with the (1.26)-(1.29) Phillips-curve identity and a general-n one-predetermined-variable solution theory; the investment model linearised as exact derivatives; Proposition 5.1 (positivity corrected), the quasi-differenced form and the limits as adjustment costs grow; the IS block with exact root location, Proposition 5.2 (corrected statement) and n-dimensional forward determinacy for (3.36).
source: Michael Woodford, Interest and Prices: Foundations of a Theory of Monetary Policy, Princeton University Press, 2003, Chapter 5, pp. 320-380, and Appendix D, pp. 687-691.
